Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material.why: Makes single-lane 224G high-speed copper communication cable, in scaled delivery as the main product of its high-speed cable business, and pushes it into AI computing and data centers (448G in customer validation); high-speed cable revenue rose 237.99% in 2025, so AI data-center copper interconnect build-out directly drives its communication cable segment.
Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material.evidence: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026): single-lane 224G high-speed communication cable keeps adding variants and remains in scaled delivery as the main product of the high-speed cable business; H1 2026 high-speed communication cable revenue RMB 6.31 hundred million, up 35.44%; the company is promoting high-speed cable applications in AI computing and data centers.

players.product: Single-lane 224G high-speed copper communication cable (twinax wire for DAC / server cable assemblies); single-lane 448G cable in customer validation and PCIe 7.0 high-speed cable in small-batch trial production

quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 4,653,091,807.21, up 17.94% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 566,683,920.66, up 1.54%; overall gross margin 29.41%, down 3.04 percentage points; R&D spending RMB 266,693,185.25, up 28.39%. The company attributes the revenue growth mainly to communication cable, new-energy-vehicle products and electronic materials, and the rise in costs to continued raw-material price increases, exchange losses on the US dollar and Hong Kong dollar, and more R&D and market development.

quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Communication cable segment (2026 half-year report; run by subsidiary Huizhou Leting Zhilian Technology): H1 2026 revenue RMB 1,551,939,924.08, 33.35% of company revenue, up 24.55%, of which high-speed communication cable revenue RMB 6.31 hundred million, up 35.44% - the report calls high-speed cable the main support of the segment's growth, on global computing-infrastructure build-out, faster large-model iteration and robotics / industrial-automation demand. Segment gross margin 18.79%, down 2.94%, mainly because raw-material prices kept rising. Huizhou Leting Zhilian Technology: H1 revenue RMB 1,582,789,666.79, net profit RMB 92,269,189.74; Leting Wire (Vietnam) posted a loss of RMB 1,659.19 ten-thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: segment RMB 1,551,939,924.08 (+24.55%); high-speed cable RMB 6.31 hundred million (+35.44%); segment margin 18.79%

quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: High-speed cable generations (2026 half-year report): single-lane 224G high-speed communication cable keeps adding product variants and remains in scaled delivery as the main product of the high-speed cable business; sample development of the next-generation single-lane 448G high-speed cable is complete, samples of some specifications met customer requirements in testing, and 448G has entered small-batch trial production and customer processing validation.

quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (2026 half-year report): as high-speed communication cable capacity keeps rising, industry competition is getting fiercer; end customers' technical-scheme upgrades raise the performance requirements on high-speed cable, and the changeover between old and new projects, product validation and project introduction take time, so end-market demand lags to some extent.

quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (2026 half-year report): the Rosendahl foamed core-wire extrusion equipment ordered earlier has all arrived and is installed at the Huizhou Shuikou and Vietnam bases; the company will pace commissioning and production by market and order demand. The Huizhou Shuikou industrial park and Vietnam Bac Ninh province capacity expansion projects are progressing as planned. Fixed assets rose mainly because the communication cable business bought machinery to expand capacity.

quarterly_data.quarter: Woer Heat-Shrinkable Material half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Construction in progress (2026 half-year report): imported foamed core-wire extruder production line - budget RMB 434,201,400.00, cumulative investment 72.81% of budget, 75.00% complete; Huizhou Huicheng Shuikou industrial park expansion (an R&D, production and sales base mainly for high-performance communication cable and polymer foam materials) - budget RMB 570,000,000.00, 11.12% of budget, 25.00% complete; the board approved up to RMB 15 hundred million of self-raised funds for the Shuikou expansion on December 16, 2025 and construction has started. The same board meeting approved up to RMB 10 hundred million for overseas production bases - up to RMB 50,000 ten-thousand to expand the Vietnam base and up to RMB 50,000 ten-thousand for a new base in Malaysia - still in progress.
